paragraphs.text: When I will deliver my Church, which consists of both Jews and Gentiles.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: It appears that he alludes to the great victory of Jehoshaphat, whom God used without man's help to destroy the enemies, 2Ch 20:20-26; also he is referring to this word Jehoshaphat, which signifies pleading or judgment, because God would judge the enemies of his Church, as he did there.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That which the enemy received for the sale of my people, they bestowed upon harlots and drink.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: given a boy for an harlot

paragraphs.text: He takes the cause of his Church in hand against the enemy, as though the injury were done to himself.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: what have ye to do with

paragraphs.text: Have I done you wrong, that you will render me the same?
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: For afterward God sold them by Nebuchadnezzar and Alexander the Great, because of the love he had for his people, and by this they were comforted, as though they themselves had sold them.
paragraphs.label: f
paragraphs.anchor: shall sell them to the Sabeans

paragraphs.text: When I will execute my judgments against my enemies, I will cause everyone to be ready, and to prepare their weapons to destroy one another, for my Church's sake.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: In this way he will encourage the enemies when their wickedness is completely ripe to destroy one another, which he calls the valley of God's judgment.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: God assures his own against all trouble, that when he destroys his enemies, his children will be delivered.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: The strangers will no longer destroy his Church: and if they do, it is the fault of the people, who by their sins make the breach for the enemy.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: He promises to his Church abundance of graces, see Geneva "Eze 47:1", which would water and comfort the most barren places; Am 9:13.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: The malicious enemies will have no part of these graces.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: He had allowed his Church before this to lie in their filthiness, but now he promises to cleanse them and to make them pure unto himself.
